name: Skill Forge Pipeline
description: Trasforma appunti grezzi in SKILL.md eseguibile con critique loop

stages.name: Intake & Decomposition
actions: Parse user raw input (appunti, transcript, idee)
Identify: obiettivo principale, target agent, trigger conditions, vincoli
Check memory/strategies for 'SKILL.md Executable Format' pattern
Decompose into: core purpose, trigger rules, operational rules, workflow steps

stages.name: SKILL.md Generation
actions: Load prompt template from prompts/skill-forge-v2.md
Inject structured_brief into [INPUT GREZZO] placeholder
Inject context from memory/knowledge/base.json best practices
Generate SKILL.md with all 6 required sections

stages.name: Quality Critique
actions: Score draft on 5 dimensions (see prompt criteria)
Calculate weighted total score
Identify specific weaknesses with line references
Compare against best practices in memory

stages.name: Refinement Loop
actions: Apply critique feedback to draft
Strengthen weak dimensions specifically
Ensure all 6 sections meet quality thresholds
Preserve what already works (don't rewrite good parts)

stages.name: Output + Memory Save
actions: Final sanity check (format, completeness, executability)
Save SKILL.md to skills/ directory
Update memory/decisions with generation metadata
Update memory/strategies with success pattern if score > 8
Present to user
